title: A £2 game with a £10 prize
caption: In six equally likely rolls the player wins £8 net once and loses £2 five times: (8 − 5 × 2)/6 = −1/3, so about −33p a game.
alt: Bar chart of six equally likely rolls: five bars of net −£2 and one of net +£8, with mean −1/3.
description: Net result is −£2 on five of the six faces and £10 − £2 = +£8 on a six.
Weighting by frequency, the mean is (5 × (−2) + 1 × 8)/6 = −1/3.
